scope: 48 US food slugs excluding the two approved samples chicken-breast and steak. Multiple existing variants remain separate conditions; this is a dependency-gap audit, not physical cooking validation. complete means no blocking dependency found in the existing instructions, not that every optional seasoning has a measured recipe. enrich entries with full replacement fields were verified at their own primary sources; equipment-only and unresolved entries are explicitly identified.

items.reason: Named baking-powder rub lacked quantities; original recipe now checked.
items.sourceEvidence: Original recipe card: ingredients and instructions, lines 283–300. Twenty wing pieces; measured baking-powder rub; 400°F, 16–22 minutes, halfway shake. No crowded-basket timing adopted.
ingredients: 1 tsp each kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder and sweet paprika
1/2 tsp dried oregano; 1/4 tsp each thyme and ground sage

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: Allow about 10 minutes to dry and coat the wings; no mandatory marinade.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 16–22 minutes per single-layer batch; shake halfway.

items.preheatDetail: Recipe card does not specify a preheat duration; retain the appliance-dependent setting.
steps: Dry the wings thoroughly. Lightly oil the basket.
Mix the measured seasonings and baking powder; toss with wings until evenly coated.
Arrange one layer, without stacking. Cook at the existing 400°F setting, shaking halfway.
items.completion: Keep the existing poultry thermometer check; color alone is insufficient.
ingredientsZh: 粗盐、蒜粉、洋葱粉、甜红椒粉各1 tsp
干牛至1/2 tsp；百里香、鼠尾草粉各1/4 tsp

timelineZh.label: 准备
timelineZh.detail: 约10分钟，用于吸干和拌料；无需强制腌制。

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 每批单层16–22分钟，中途摇篮。

items.preheatDetailZh: 菜谱卡没有给出预热时长；保留依设备要求决定的设定。
stepsZh: 彻底吸干鸡翅；炸篮薄喷一层油。
将称量好的调料与泡打粉混合，和鸡翅拌匀。
单层摆放、不叠放；沿用400°F设定，中途摇篮。
items.completionZh: 保留现有禽肉中心温度检查；不能只凭颜色判断。

items.reason: Generic seasoning omitted the original lemon/spice preparation; original checked.

ingredients: 1 tsp each kosher salt, garlic powder and onion powder
1/2 tsp sweet paprika; 1/2 tsp dried herbs such as oregano

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: About 5 minutes; rub on lemon juice and seasonings. No brine or long marinade required.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 12 minutes skin-side down, then turn and cook another 12 minutes.

items.preheatDetail: The recipe does not specify preheating; do not invent a duration.
steps: Rub both sides with the half-lemon juice and measured spices.
Place skin-side down in one layer; cook batches if six do not fit.
Cook at the existing 400°F setting; turn after 12 minutes.
items.completion: Check the thickest part away from bone; retain 165°F minimum.
ingredientsZh: 粗盐、蒜粉、洋葱粉各1 tsp
甜红椒粉1/2 tsp；干香草（如牛至）1/2 tsp

timelineZh.label: 准备
timelineZh.detail: 约5分钟，抹柠檬汁和调料；无需盐水浸泡或长时间腌制。

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 鸡皮朝下12分钟，翻面后再烹饪12分钟。

items.preheatDetailZh: 原文未规定预热，不补造预热时长。
stepsZh: 两面抹上1/2个柠檬的汁及称量好的调料。
鸡皮朝下单层摆放；6块放不下时分批。
沿用400°F设定，在12分钟时翻面。
items.completionZh: 在最厚处避开骨头测温，保留最低165°F要求。

items.reason: Dry rub lacked a recipe and optional refrigerated waiting time; original PDF checked.
items.sourceEvidence: NIFS one-page PDF: ingredients lines 8–16, coating and optional 30-minute fridge rest lines 18–22, air-fryer method lines 23–26.
ingredients: 8 raw chicken drumsticks, about 4 oz each
1 tbsp garlic powder; 1 tbsp onion powder
equipment: Large lidded bowl or 1-gallon food bag

timeline.label: Optional rest
timeline.detail: For more flavor, refrigerate coated drumsticks for 30 minutes; this is optional.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 20 minutes as the first check, turning at 10 minutes.

items.preheatDetail: Preheat to 400°F; the PDF gives no number of minutes.
steps: Combine all dry-rub ingredients in a lidded bowl or food bag.
Add drumsticks and shake until coated. Cook now or use the optional refrigerated rest.
Place in one layer; cook at the existing setting and turn at 10 minutes.
items.completion: Verify 165°F internally; continue if the 20-minute check is below target.
notes: The original explicitly permits another rub. No wet marinade or breading is required.

timelineZh.label: 可选静置

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 20分钟时首次检查，10分钟时翻面。

stepsZh: 将所有干调料放入带盖大碗或食品袋中混匀。
加入鸡腿摇匀至表面裹满，可立即烹饪或先按可选步骤冷藏。
单层放入，沿用现有设定，10分钟时翻面。
items.completionZh: 中心达到165°F；20分钟检查时不足则继续烹饪。
notesZh: 原作者允许替换其他干香料，不需要湿腌或裹粉。

ingredients: 3 lb fully thawed boneless, skin-on turkey breast roast
2 tsp kosher salt; 1/4 tsp black pepper
1 tbsp each finely chopped fresh sage, thyme and rosemary
equipment: Air fryer large enough for the roast

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: About 10 minutes; mix butter and season roast. No overnight brine required.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 20 minutes skin-side up, turn, then another 20 minutes as the check.

timeline.label: Rest
timeline.detail: 10 minutes before slicing.

items.preheatDetail: Preheat to 350°F for 3–4 minutes. Use Roast if available, as the reference directs.
steps: Combine softened butter, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper.
Dry roast; gently loosen skin and spread butter underneath and over the exterior.
Start skin-side up. Turn at 20 minutes; check the thickest center at the existing cook time.
items.completion: Cook to 165°F; rest 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Check the product for added brine/salt and reduce seasoning accordingly. Different weights or shapes are not covered by a multiplier.
ingredientsZh: 3 lb完全解冻的去骨带皮火鸡胸肉卷
新鲜鼠尾草、百里香、迷迭香各切细1 tbsp
equipmentZh: 容量足够容纳肉卷的空气炸锅

timelineZh.label: 准备
timelineZh.detail: 约10分钟，混合黄油并抹肉；无需隔夜盐水腌制。

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 皮朝上20分钟，翻面后再20分钟并检查。

timelineZh.label: 静置
timelineZh.detail: 切片前静置10分钟。

items.preheatDetailZh: 350°F预热3–4分钟；设备有Roast（烘烤）模式时按原文使用。
stepsZh: 混合软化黄油、蒜末、香草、盐和黑胡椒。
吸干肉卷，轻轻松开外皮，把香草黄油抹在皮下和外表面。
先皮朝上，20分钟时翻面；到现有烹饪时间后检查最厚处中心。
items.completionZh: 中心达到165°F，切片前静置10分钟。
notesZh: 查看产品是否已经注盐水或加盐，酌减调味；不同重量或形状不能用倍数推算时间。

1/2 tsp each garlic and onion powder; 1/4 tsp black pepper
equipment: Mixing bowl and small egg bowl

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: About 20 minutes to mix and form roughly twenty 1 1/2-inch balls; keep beef cold.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 7–9 minutes per batch; turn halfway.

items.preheatDetail: Preheat to 400°F; original does not specify minutes.
steps: Combine Parmesan, crumbs and dry seasonings. Beat egg separately.
Add cold beef and egg; mix gently without compressing. Shape equal 1 1/2-inch balls.
Spray basket and meatball tops. Arrange apart in one layer, cook at the existing setting and turn halfway.
notes: Poultry alternatives in the original are outside this beef-only condition. Optional oven holding is not needed to complete a batch.
ingredientsZh: 帕尔马干酪碎1/3 cup；意式调味面包糠1/3 cup
粗盐1 tsp；意式综合香料1 tsp
蒜粉、洋葱粉各1/2 tsp；黑胡椒1/4 tsp

timelineZh.label: 准备
timelineZh.detail: 约20分钟，混合并捏成约20个1 1/2-inch肉丸；牛肉保持冷藏状态至使用。

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 每批7–9分钟，中途翻面。

items.preheatDetailZh: 预热至400°F；原文未给出分钟数。
stepsZh: 混合干酪、面包糠和干调料，另碗打散鸡蛋。
加入冷牛绞肉和蛋液，轻拌均匀、不压实；捏成大小一致的1 1/2-inch肉丸。
炸篮和肉丸顶部喷油；单层留空摆放，沿用现有设定并中途翻面。
items.completionZh: 参考菜谱要求中心达到165°F。
notesZh: 原作者的禽肉替代方案不属于本牛肉丸条件；完成单批不需要另用烤箱保温。

Mix Dijon, vinegar, oil and Italian seasoning. Brush all sides; add salt and pepper.
Place in the hot basket; cut crosswise only if needed to fit. Cook at the existing setting and measure the thickest center.
items.completion: Retain the app’s 145°F minimum before removal, then rest at least 5 minutes.
notes: Use tenderloin, not the much thicker pork loin. The original allows early removal for carryover; the app must retain its stricter minimum-before-removal policy.

items.preheatDetailZh: 预热至375°F；原文没有规定预热分钟数。
steps: Cut across into uniform 3/8–1/2-inch rounds; discard the leafy end. Pat dry.
Brush both sides with oil. Apply salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, then Parmesan, in that order.
Arrange in one layer. Cook at the existing 375°F setting for 10–12 minutes; repeat in batches.
stepsZh: 横切成厚薄一致的3/8–1/2-inch圆片，丢弃蒂部，吸干表面。
两面刷油，依次撒上海盐、黑胡椒、意式香料，最后撒帕尔马干酪。
单层放入，沿用375°F烹饪10–12分钟；剩余茄子分批处理。
items.completion: Flesh must be very soft and cheese golden; check the interior, not only surface color.
items.completionZh: 内部须十分柔软、干酪呈金黄；检查内部，不只观察表面颜色。
notes: Use a medium eggplant. Fine grated Parmesan is essential for this coating; no breadcrumbs, sauce or egg wash required.
notesZh: 使用中等大小茄子；这种涂层使用细粉状帕尔马干酪，不需要面包糠、酱料或蛋液。

ingredients: 8 French baguette slices, about 1 inch thick
Optional: grated Parmesan, salt and pepper

timeline.label: Prepare
timeline.detail: About 5 minutes; butter must already be softened. No proofing or raw dough step.

timeline.label: Cook
timeline.detail: 3–5 minutes per batch; watch closely near the end.

steps: Mince peeled garlic and mix with softened butter and Italian seasoning.
Spread generously to the edges of the one-inch baguette slices; add optional toppings.
Put slices apart in the hot basket; cook at the existing setting in batches if needed.
items.completion: Remove at desired crispness, before garlic burns.
notes: Fresh baked baguette only; this condition does not cover frozen toast or uncooked dough.
ingredientsZh: 可选：帕尔马干酪碎、盐和黑胡椒

timelineZh.label: 准备
timelineZh.detail: 约5分钟；黄油须提前软化，无需发酵，也不处理生面团。

timelineZh.label: 烹饪
timelineZh.detail: 每批3–5分钟，末段密切观察。

items.preheatDetailZh: 预热至350°F；原文未给出时长。
stepsZh: 蒜去皮切末，与软化黄油和意式香料混合。
将蒜黄油充分涂到1-inch厚法棍片的边缘，可加可选配料。
放入热炸篮，相互留空；沿用现有设定，放不下时分批。
items.completionZh: 达到喜欢的酥脆程度即可取出，避免蒜末焦苦。
notesZh: 用已烤熟的新鲜法棍，本条件不适用于冷冻吐司或生面团。
